limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance only; no physical, clinical or method validity is established.
The 1986 t intervals use approximate limit variance 3s squared/n under independent normal differences; the moment screen does not establish normality or constant variance.
The exact t tail describes a model-based linear-regression test, not an assumption-free test. A nonsignificant test cannot establish absent proportional bias.
Natural-log inputs require positive measurements. Replicates collapse on the original scale before transformation and never increase independent n.
Hashes cannot establish historical freeze timing or true source independence. The pack always leaves independent review unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, interchange*, equivalen* and method valid*. Any correlat* headline/claim wording is refused. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computation and review approval never support positive claims; one synthetic fixture never establishes replication.
Read-only inputs are bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
